plainLanguage: In two small studies, about two months of chest training made the chest muscle measurably thicker.
qualifiers: Three usable trials, all small, and they are the same three the appraisal section 2.1 table lists: a machine-fly trial, a horizontal-versus-incline bench press trial, and a low-load bench press versus push-up trial. The first pass said "two" while citing three, which left a reader unable to tell which trials the claim rested on.
One of the three prints identical pectoralis major values for both of its randomised arms, so only the direction of its result is used and none of its numbers is carried.

Ten further eligible tier-1 trials could not be read in full and are recorded as awaiting full text. The acquisition ladder was executed and recorded for all ten on 2026-09-13; all ten remain closed to this client.
Measured by B-mode ultrasound at one or three sites, and the imaging plane, the measurement site and operator experience all change the number obtained.
Neither trial establishes a dose, and none is a comparison between the two exercises in this slice.

conditions: 8 weeks; machine butterfly at 10-12RM three times weekly, or bench press once or twice weekly
scope.population: untrained and recreationally active adults aged about 19 to 30

statement: Eight weeks of supervised chest resistance training increased pectoralis major muscle thickness in untrained and recreationally active adults, in three small trials using different exercises.
